sources.title: Xiangqi.com — Learning the Xiangqi Pieces and Moves
sources.excerpt: Xiangqi pieces stand on intersections. A Horse moves one orthogonal point and then one diagonal point; an intervening piece blocks that direction and blocks the Horse's leg. A Cannon captures by jumping over exactly one intervening screen or mount. An Elephant moves two points diagonally, cannot pass a blocking piece, and cannot cross the river. An Advisor moves one diagonal point inside the palace. A General moves one orthogonal point inside the palace and the Generals cannot face one another on an empty file. Soldiers gain sideways movement after crossing the river.

sources.title: Chess.com — How To Play Chinese Chess (Xiangqi)
sources.excerpt: Xiangqi pieces are placed on intersections and the board is divided by a river. Horses cannot jump: a piece on the intervening point blocks the Horse in that direction. Elephants move two diagonal points, cannot cross the river, and are blocked by a piece in their path. Cannons capture after jumping over one piece. Advisors and Generals are restricted to the palace, and Generals may not face each other directly.
